MUFFIT is an optimized code to retrieve the main physical parameters of galaxies in multi-filter surveys, which is able to provide accurate stellar population parameters for a large fraction of galaxies in ALhAMBRA, and it is a powerful tool for the analysis of large galaxy samples.

MUFFIT is an optimized code to derive stellar populations parameters for galaxies from multi-filter surveys, providing reliable information for their ages, metallicities and redshifts, with a precision of ∼10–15% in stellar masses.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the combination of multi-filter photometric surveys with optimized stellar population diagnostic techniques, like Muffit, can be used to derive robust physical properties of galaxies at different redshift bins, even when the data are not spectroscopically complete.
MUFFIT can be used to derive the main stellar population properties of galaxies from the local Universe to z ∼ 1, using photometric data from multi-filter surveys.
